title: Stage menu in a drawer or the split preview: after a 409 the record is not re-read, so a second Move sends the same stale version
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oLLK7uoxp33riiBJL

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding while building #36036 (PR #36296, os-dev-report on #36036, PR `## Acceptance notes`), confirmed on main by the L1-d review (ACCEPT 7074671197, "Out-of-scope item 1"). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.
Dedupe: `stage 409 drawer` (open: 8 hits, none on this — #36036 #35995 #36078 #35483 #31527 are other subjects), `headerRefresh` (1 hit, #35593 closed, the header one-row redo). No card covers it.

## What happens (read on `origin/main` 4ab12189, not driven live)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` sets `const headerRefresh = embedded ? undefined : handleManualRefresh;` and hands it to the header's `RecordContextProvider` as `refresh`. The `undefined` is the opt-out that keeps the ⟳ button off drawers and the split preview.
- The header's stage slot is wired without an `embedded` gate (`stage: (parts) => <RecordStageMenu {...parts} />`).
- The stage menu's save path (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`) answers a 409 `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` with `ctx?.refresh?.()`, so the record is re-read and the next Move is judged against what is stored (#35956, #36036).
- In a drawer or the split preview `ctx.refresh` is `undefined`: the 409 re-reads nothing, the dialog keeps the old row, and a second Move sends the same stale `ifMatch` and is refused again. #36036's fix (fields recomputed from the re-read row) also never gets a new row there.

reach: unmeasured whether the stage menu actually draws in the drawer and preview headers. That is the first thing to measure.

## Ask

1. Measure whether `RecordStageMenu` draws in the record drawer and the split preview header. If it does not, close this card with the reading.
2. If it does, give the header a re-read that works in embedded mode while keeping the ⟳ button off drawers and the preview: separate "show a refresh button" from "re-read the record" instead of overloading `refresh`. Pin: a 409 in an embedded header re-reads the record, and a second Move carries the new version; CONTROL that the ⟳ button stays hidden when embedded.

## Facts for the builder

- The fix point is `RecordDetailView.tsx`, which seat 1 was editing in this period; check overlap before starting.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` expected.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell`, record drawer and preview header) · area:ux · Bug.
